Class: EvSmartRoutingResponse

bemap.EvSmartRoutingResponse(options)

new EvSmartRoutingResponse(options)

BeNomad BeMap JavaScript API - EvSmartRoutingResponse (v1.5) Strongly-typed response parser. `fromJson()` accepts both the REST **v1.0** shape (single `journey` + `route`) and the REST **v2.0.0** shape (`journeys[]` of `{summary, events[]}`), exposing both through the same getters. Wire shapes mirror `EvSmartRoutingResponse` server-side (`bemap_idea/.../service/{v1_0_0,v2_0_0}/model/evSmartRouting/response/EvSmartRoutingResponse.java`): { logTag, journey: { distance, duration, batteryLevel, consumed, chargingTime, chargingCost, departureTime, arrivalTime, vehicle, savedCo2Emissions }, inputInfo, boundingBox, route: { stepPoints, polyline?, encodedPolyline?, events?, timeSlotWarns? } }
Parameters:
Name Type Description
options Object Parsed JSON response from the server.

getBoundingBox() → {bemap.BoundingBox|null}

`bemap.BoundingBox` covering the whole journey, or `null` when absent. `fromJson` already lifts `{topLeft, bottomRight}` to a `bemap.BoundingBox`, so under normal conditions this returns a `bemap.BoundingBox`. If the BoundingBox lift failed (e.g. malformed payload), the raw JSON object is returned so callers can still inspect it.

getEncodedPolyline() → {String|Array.<String>|null}

Google-encoded polyline. On a **v1** response this is a single `String`; on a **v2** response it is an `Array.` — one encoded string per ROUTE segment, since v2 splits the geometry across ROUTE events. `null` when absent.
